title: Yearly Cap on Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Cap.** The late fees on an enrollment's Pre-K tuition account in a school year never total more than 150.00 under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions. The limit on a late fee is worked out from the late fees already posted on that enrollment in the school year:

| Late fees already posted on the enrollment in the school year | Limit on the late fee now assessed |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | nothing: no late fee can be charged |
| above zero and below 150.00 | 150.00 less those fees |
| none | the fee is not limited by the cap (the schedule enters the limit as 99999.00, a figure no late fee reaches) |

A late fee is never more than its limit.

## Worked limits (hypothetical enrollments)

| Late fees already posted this school year | Limit | A fee figured at 38.00 is charged |
|---|---|---|
| none | not limited | 38.00 |
| 60.00 | 90.00 | 38.00 |
| 130.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 |
| 150.00 | nothing | nothing |

The cap counts only the late fees on the same enrollment in the same school year, as posted.
